description: The Commander conducted a deliberate diagnostic test — sealing the habitat closed for 10 hours after air quality had otherwise improved — to isolate the cause of the recurring CO2/TVOC buildup. Both readings rose back to problem levels during the closure, confirming closure itself (not another factor) as the primary driver.
response: The crew reopened the station and returned to open-door/fan ventilation. The result was used to support a recommendation for a proper ventilation or ECLSS system in future analogue seasons, rather than relying on manual door/fan management.
lesson: Where a suspected cause (e.g. sealed-habitat CO2/TVOC buildup) can be isolated with a short deliberate test, run one — it converts a recurring nuisance into a confirmed root cause and a concrete infrastructure recommendation for future crews.
